units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 7:12">Targ. Ex. VII, 12</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Chullin 111a:4">Ḥull. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>כי היכי דפליט הדר ב׳</he> as it gives out, so does it again absorb; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="B00873"><he>בְּלִיעַ</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00873"><he>בְּלִיעָא</he></cite>.
Snh. 110ᵃ בלועי דקרח, v. בְּלִיעֵי.— Trnsf. to receive blows (cmp. סָפַג).
<cite ref="Menachot 7a:8">Men. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>קולפי טאבי בַּלְעִי וכ׳</he> I received many blows at the hands of Ab. over &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 56a">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite>.—Targ. II, <cite ref="Esther 3:7">Esth. III, 7</cite> <he>בְּלִיעָן אינון בידי</he> they are swallowed up (bound to be destroyed) by my hand.
<cite ref="Chullin 67b:12">Ḥull. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>אַבְלַע לי</he> let me swallow them (put them in my mouth).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 64a:2">B. Mets. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>וא׳ ליה בחשבון</he>, v. <cite ref="B00898">preced.</cite> Hif.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 46:21">Targ. Y. Gen. XLVI, 21</cite> <he>אתב׳ מניה</he> he was swallowed up (disappeared) from his side; v. <cite ref="B00898">preced.</cite>

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 6:5">Targ. Josh. VI, 5</cite> <he>יתבלע וכ׳</he> shall sink into the ground beneath it; a. e.—Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵃ bot. <he>איתב׳ מן קומוי</he> (the moon) disappeared from his sight.

senses.gloss: to be given to eat; trnsf. to be taught.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 24b:5">Ber. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>הא מילתא אִבְלְעָא לי בי וכ׳</he> v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) this I have been taught in the school of R. &c.; (<cite ref="Menachot 17a:10">Men. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>הא מילתא אבלע לי וכ׳</he> this has R. Ḥ. taught me).
